name: oh-my-context-mod
description: Routes every plugin and user MCP server through one oh-my-context gateway (bundled, nothing downloaded) and lists skills by name only (or hides them from Claude's own list with hide_skills, found through the gateway's resolve_skills and load_skill), so tool names and skill descriptions stop filling the context while every tool and skill still works. Sets itself up at session start and puts everything back when it is disabled or uninstalled. /oh-my-context-mod shows what moved and turns it off. Also adds terse reply modes (off, lite, full, ultra, max), set with /omc mode.

direct_servers.title: MCP servers kept direct
direct_servers.description: Comma-separated MCP servers that stay connected to Claude directly instead of going through oh-my-context: a server name, a plugin name or plugin:<plugin>:<server>. Blank routes them all. Run /oh-my-context-mod to list every server the mod found.

direct_skills.title: Skills kept fully listed
direct_skills.description: Comma-separated skills that keep their full description in Claude's skill listing: a skill name, <plugin>:<skill>, or a plugin name for its whole skill set. Blank routes them all; routed skills stay listed by name and invocable.

hide_skills.title: Hide skills from Claude's list
hide_skills.description: Blank (default) keeps skills listed by name only. Set to true to hide every routed skill from Claude's own list (you can still type /name); Claude then finds them with the gateway's resolve_skills and loads them with load_skill. A comma-separated list of plugin or skill names hides only those. Skills named in direct_skills stay listed. Applies from the next session.
